experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1 and 9.8 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT): seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of the work register W against WB, the 39 context lines once; per member its words of step CO, X0 and w3 at s = 0 and the member lines of the Y9 path, then its walk over the first 2^10 steps s, t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^16); per block of constant X0 >> 16, omega mod 2^16 and the level-16 state of automaton (2), a dead block ending there; per live block its W addition, the cut of its X0 interval into aligned pieces and ranges of high halves, and its passing high halves read from its state's list; per range its W addition for its words and lanes; per list word its packed Y9 fill; per E lane T1's replica ORed into one accumulator; per word that accumulator ANDed with the listed masks of (2), and a lane scan if not zero; a passing lane with its W addition, the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7 and the preflight of the metered cap CM(T); the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) on the source bank and the root predicate; for the first certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. In the same run every block's omega is checked against step CO at its own t_hi at sampled steps, every 8th E lane against step CO, bit-serial masks and a real compression of its step-CT message at counter t, every passing lane's words, pre-check and bank against a scalar rebuild, every metered debit against the ledger, every solver call repeated without G15 with real-compression certificates, the identities of the counter contract per live block, member and context, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: blocks, live (blocks whose level-16 state is live), ranges (ranges of high halves read from the lists), words (packed list words), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, prechecked, solver_calls, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), checks, mismatches (a failed in-run check or identity of the counter contract counts as one), halted and live_steps (steps of live blocks). Expected per trial: about 8 blocks, 0.8 of them live, 8 ranges, 64 words, 414 E lanes, 7.6 passes and 2 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. In the run of this request by the author of entry 643db72a, whose program visits the same steps (only the units differ): 2,079 blocks, 205 live, 2,074 ranges, 16,441 words, 106,030 E lanes, 1,936 passes, 517 solver calls, no root, 68,929 checks, 0 mismatches. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
